newsitem.title: UK: OFFER says agrees trading change with Scottish cos.
newsitem.headline: OFFER says agrees trading change with Scottish cos.

text.p: Electricity industry regulator OFFER said it reached agreement with Scottish Power and Scottish Hydro-Electric on changes to the basis on which the companies make electricity available to other suppliers.
OFFER said that in 1995/96, the pool purchase price basis was around six percent lower than the pool selling price.
The change will be effective for one year from April 1, 1997.
OFFER director general Stephen Littlechild said the change is expected to reduce prices to customers in the competitive market by between three and five percent.
Littlechild said he had agreed to run the change for one year and re-examine the issue as part of a review on the appropriate form of supply price restraint after 1998.
